content.text: 0 of 15 secondsVolume 0%This ad will end in 200:1300:0100:15 McIlroy assumes role at 'head of the table' without Tiger and Phil at the Masters April 12, 2026 09:18 PM During “Live From the Masters” after the final round at Augusta, Golf Channel's Rich Lerner, said he believes that after winning his second Masters, without Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson, that Rory McIlroy has assumed the role at the "head of the table" in golf. Rory McIlroy not only won his second consecutive Masters title; he earned the largest payout in tournament history.McIlroy claimed $4.5 million from the record $22.5 million purse at the season’s first major at Augusta National Golf Club.He collected $4.2 million for his victory a year ago. Rory McIlroy has become the fourth back-to-back winner in Masters history.
